description: A raptor-infested cave system under Fangrock. Fight through the den and pit to the Raptor Chieftain's throne. Recommended level 6.

actions.text: The Raptor Chieftain falls. A hoard is revealed.
The carving shows three glyphs: triangle, circle, square. Pull the levers in that order.
Stone clicks somewhere in the wall.
Another click. One lever to go.
The levers lock in. The rockfall grinds aside and a cache is revealed.
Wrong order. The levers slam back and the cave stirs.
